fams={
 'sum2_pow': lambda p: p[0]*P**p[1]*t**p[2]+p[3]*P**p[4]*t**p[5],
 'sum2_pow_exp': lambda p: p[0]*P**p[1]*t**p[2]+p[3]*P**p[4]*t**p[5]+p[6]*P**p[7],
 'prodexp': lambda p: p[0]*P**p[1]*(1+p[2]*t**p[3]*P**p[4]),
 'P_tlog': lambda p: p[0]*P**p[1]*(1+p[2]*t**p[3]) + p[4]*P**p[5]*t**p[6],
 'sat': lambda p: p[0]*P**p[1]*t**p[2]/(1+p[3]*P**p[4]) + p[5]*P**p[6]*t**p[7],
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for name,f in fams.items():
    best=None
    for trial in range(30):
        p0=rng.uniform(0.2,2,size=10)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0, max_nfev=3000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(name, nmse(f(best.x)), np.round(best.x,4))
